commands.title: Character sheet
commands.description: Show your sheet, or set values on it: NAME=VALUE (also += and -=), or the dice-bot form NAME VALUE. A value may be dice. clear deletes your character; finalize resets its current pools for its final characteristics.

text.usage: .st [show] | .st STR=60 HP-=2 | .st 力量60 敏捷50 | .st clear | .st finalize

commands.title: New character
commands.description: Make a new character in a rule system with its creation word (.coc, .dnd) and play it.

commands.title: Character from a description
commands.description: Describe a character in words and get a rule-legal sheet in the room's rule system (or the one you name), as your character. The model proposes an occupation, the attributes to favour and a few skills; the numbers are rolled and placed by the rules.

commands.title: House rule
commands.description: Show the room's rule system and house-rule ladder, or (room admin) choose another.

commands.title: Uploads on/off
commands.description: Show whether members may upload files to this room, or (room admin) allow or stop uploads.

commands.title: Import a card
commands.description: Bring in a card — a file you uploaded for import, or one a pack enabled here ships: as the room's world (room admin), or as your character.

text.usage: .import world <file hash> | .import character <file hash> [name] | .import world <pack> <card path> | .import character <pack> <card path> [name]

commands.title: Packs
commands.description: See the content packs this room plays with; the room admin sees every installed pack, installs one on the server (it is enabled here at once), and enables or disables them here.

commands.title: Session report
commands.description: The session so far as a keepsake: a short scoreboard, or the whole session as one HTML page to save. A room admin may ask for the reveal edition, which also prints what was hidden from the players.

commands.title: Model settings
commands.description: See which provider and model each lane of the Keeper uses; the room admin switches them, sets a key, asks a provider for its models, or goes back to the server's own settings. Server-wide: every room follows.

commands.title: Sound effect
